description: $0.001 per call. Use to grade your own rug or graduation calls or backtest a signal with labels you did not write (for a live check use check_pumpfun_risk): the outcome of ONE pump.fun launch by a fixed public rule from our capture: whether it rugged (a drain from a peak of at least 5 SOL, or a creator dump) and when, whether within 300 s, whether it truly graduated and when, the creator's first sell, peak and last curve SOL, the mayhem flag, whether each label is settled. Labels settle about an hour after the curve goes quiet and read null until then, never a provisional false. No probabilities, no opinions. Input: mint (a mint or a pump.fun/gmgn/solscan/birdeye link). A mint we never saw answers known:false and is charged like any answer; a malformed mint is refused before payment.

mint.description: Any pump.fun mint (base58, 32-44 characters); one we never saw answers known:false. Accepts a mint or a pump.fun/gmgn/solscan/birdeye link.
